description: Creates or updates one view in Development from gemmein/views/<name>.json's contents ({ collection, filter?, sort?, columns?, totals?, layout, actions? }): one collection, a filter in the owner's own timezone, sort, the columns and totals it shows, its layout (table, cards, calendar or board) and the action buttons that move a record from one state to another. A view's collection is fixed after creation — push a new view for a different collection. The same view answers dev_view/live_view and the dashboard's own Views page; its numbers always match. This is what a founder may call a dashboard page, a board or a list with buttons.
name: put_view
title: Save a view
